top_bar.title.description: Settings > Libraries row and page title: the page that chooses which items the top bar shows. Short.

top_bar.detail.value: Choose what shows in the top bar.
top_bar.detail.description: Detail line under the Top bar row on the Settings root. One short sentence.

top_bar.copy.value: Pick what shows in the middle and at the top right. Settings stays on your profile.
top_bar.copy.description: Top bar page header copy: the switches hide or show items in the bar at the top of the screen; Settings itself is always reached from the profile chip, which cannot be hidden.

top_bar.section_middle.description: Top bar page: heading over the switches for the items in the middle pill of the top bar (Movies, TV Shows, Requests). Short.

top_bar.section_right.description: Top bar page: heading over the switches for the items in the pill at the top right of the top bar (Watchlist, Search). Short.
